name: smart_playlists
description: Rule-based playlist generator: builds native Volumio playlists from artist/album/genre/year/track/duration/added-date filters, with sorting and deduplication.
author: Celindir69

volumio_info.details: Generate native Volumio playlists automatically from a rules text file: artist lists with AND/OR filters on album, genre, year, title, track, duration, and days-since-added, plus custom sort order and track limits.
volumio_info.changelog: 1.0.1: keeps the rules when updating from 0.9.x (settings taken over from the old category; the default examples never overwrite the rules file).
